title: Profiling-driven persistent history optimization and sustained mixed-command qualification

status.core_gain: confirmed for the measured continuing streams
status.production_http_gain: not qualified; measured spot HTTP regression is retained below

architecture.sealed_chunk_directory: im::Vector<Arc<Chunk<T>>> instead of Arc<Vec<Arc<Vec<T>>>>; forks share directory nodes and chunks
architecture.detached_tail: Nonempty clones reserve spare capacity for append; empty clones avoid preallocating a full tail.
architecture.contracts: Rollback boundaries, command/event sequencing, JSON array format and public slice views preserved. No order-book/account algorithm change in this round.
architecture.tradeoffs: More chunk handles and directory metadata; legacy contiguous slice export still materializes full history. No peak-RSS or memory-saving claim.

profiling.method: Owned-process Windows main-thread CPU stack sampling via QueryThreadCycleTime, SuspendThread/GetThreadContext and StackWalk64 with local PDBs; resume before resolving symbols. Optimized release with debuginfo=1. Nominal 1ms sleep, actual counts retained; sampling overhead excluded from latency benchmark.
profiling.limits: Inclusive categories overlap; sample fractions are estimates, not timings. Debug profiles were unpinned and are exploratory. Unknown system symbols are not attributed to exact Windows functions. Reset/deserialization stacks excluded by apply-ancestor filter.
profiling.remaining_raw_hotspot: Order node access/mutation and persistent set/map paths. Replacing this snapshot architecture would require another correctness/rollback design, not a claimed free constant-cost improvement.

correctness.history_contract_test: Long fork copies <32 records; old materialized slice pointer and contents remain stable; shared sealed chunks and forward/reverse suffix reads preserved.

receipt.test: entire exchange-server library, single harness thread

real_http_postgres.restart_scope: Owned server process terminated after acknowledged commands, then restarted against its private DB. No power-loss/storage-crash claim.

mixed_performance.method: Same deterministic benchmark source compiled unchanged against frozen stage 2 and candidate. 100/10000 live orders, 8/64 accounts, initially 10/100 levels per side; cancel/replace, quantity reduction, outward-price amendment, partial market fills, 32-unit sweeps/replenishment. Histories start empty and grow. One full warm-up, four timed blocks per process, four processes per version (16 blocks per row). Engine/unique raw JSON resets, command clone, validation and result drop outside timers. Internal apply clone/book/risk/clearing/log/old-state drop included. Per-block first-apply lazy cache construction remains included. All command events/final books checked; spot aggregate cash/position and perp net position checked.
mixed_performance.cpu_affinity: Owned benchmark process pinned to mask 4, logical CPU 2. Windows host is i9-13900HX (24 cores/32 logical CPUs); not an isolated host.
mixed_performance.aggregation: Median of 16 block throughput measurements and median of per-block nearest-rank percentiles; these are not pooled quantiles. Throughput is reciprocal timed apply service cost, not wall/client arrival capacity.

mixed_performance.limits: Initial unpinned results were strongly inconsistent and are retained locally, not used for qualification. Even pinned raw (unchanged code) has an outlying slower process; all pinned blocks remain included. No statistically controlled confidence intervals, concurrent arrivals, multiple writers, sustained room bots, network, journal or production SLO in this core test.

data.scope: Loopback HTTP/1.1 persistent connection, one closed-loop client, real private PostgreSQL default durability. 8 accounts, 100 live orders, initial 10 price levels per side, growing histories, deterministic 400-cycle stream. Request timing includes HTTP request through complete response-body read; serialization, JSON parsing/assertions, setup, restart and idempotent replay excluded. Fresh database/server per case, before/after/after/before order. Owned API process pinned to logical CPU 2, owned PG control processes/descendants to CPU 4, client to CPU 6. No queueing/open-loop/concurrent-client or production SLO claim. No dedicated warm-up; cold first requests included.

http_interpretation: Real-PG spot throughput median decreases ~27% and p99 increases ~26% in these samples; perp improves. In-memory spot throughput also has a slow run while its p99 improves, and perp improves. These small, variable single-client samples do not prove a consistent end-to-end acceleration or isolate an HTTP regression cause. No claim that PostgreSQL specifically caused the difference. Production acceptance remains open.

microbenchmark_guards.method: Owned process pinned to logical CPU 2; otherwise each benchmark scope and sample definitions retained. Prior stage-2 qualified binaries and original frozen baseline reused, SHA256 retained. Measurements were separate sequential processes; unchanged raw costs also vary. These guards do not establish a new improvement in raw matching.

import http.client
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import socket
import statistics
import subprocess
import time
import sys
import ctypes
from ctypes import wintypes

kernel=ctypes.WinDLL('kernel32',use_last_error=True)
kernel.SetProcessAffinityMask.argtypes=[wintypes.HANDLE,ctypes.c_size_t]
kernel.SetProcessAffinityMask.restype=wintypes.BOOL
kernel.GetCurrentProcess.restype=wintypes.HANDLE
assert kernel.SetProcessAffinityMask(kernel.GetCurrentProcess(),64), ctypes.get_last_error()
memory = '--memory' in sys.argv

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
out = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
pgbin = Path('D:/SQL/bin')
data = out / 'http-postgres-data'
trace = json.loads((out/'http-trace.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('MARKETFORGE_', 'PG'))}
flags = subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW

def port():
    with socket.socket() as s:
        s.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return s.getsockname()[1]

def control(args):
    with (out/'http-pg-control.log').open('a', encoding='utf-8') as log:
        process=subprocess.Popen([str(x) for x in args], env=env, cwd=root, stdout=log,
                                 stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, creationflags=flags)
        assert kernel.SetProcessAffinityMask(process._handle,16), ctypes.get_last_error()
        assert process.wait(timeout=60)==0

def stats(values):
    values = sorted(values)
    return {'count':len(values), **{f'p{p}_us':values[math.ceil(len(values)*p/100)-1] for p in [50,95,99]},
            'max_us':values[-1], 'http_commands_per_second':len(values)*1e6/sum(values)}

def payloads():
    owners = {o['NewOrder']['order_id']:o['NewOrder']['account_id'] for o in trace['seed_orders']}
    result = []
    for command, expected in trace['trace']:
        kind, value = next(iter(command.items()))
        if kind == 'NewOrder':
            owners[value['order_id']] = value['account_id']
            account = value['account_id']
            action = {'side':value['side'], 'qty':value['qty']}
            if value['kind'] == 'Market':
                action = {'PlaceMarket':action}
            else:
                action['price_tick'] = value['kind']['Limit']['price_tick']
                action = {'PlaceLimit':action}
        else:
            account = owners[value['order_id']]
            action = {('Cancel' if kind == 'CancelOrder' else 'Amend'):
                      {k:v for k,v in value.items() if k != 'account_id'}}
        request = {'participant_id':'mixed-benchmark', 'account_id':account, 'action':action}
        result.append((json.dumps(request).encode(),expected))
    return result

requests = payloads()

def normalized_expected(events):
    return [{'type':kind, **value} for event in events for kind,value in event.items()]

def scenario(mode):
    instrument = {'instrument_id':'BENCH', 'symbol':'BENCH', 'base_asset':'BASE',
                  'quote_asset':'QUOTE', 'venue_id':'default-venue', 'tick_size':1,'lot_size':1}
    market = {'instrument':instrument,'clearing':{'maker_fee_ppm':0,'taker_fee_ppm':0},
              'risk':({'allow_short':False} if mode == 'Spot' else {})}
    if mode == 'Perp':
        market['clearing']['leverage'] = 1
        market['initial_mark_price_tick'] = 1000
    accounts = [{('Spot' if mode == 'Spot' else 'Basic'):{'account_id':i,'cash_balance':1_000_000_000_000,
                       **({'position_qty':10_000_000} if mode == 'Spot' else {})}}
                for i in range(1,9)]
    return {'room_id':'mixed', 'market':{mode:market},'accounts':accounts,'seed_orders':trace['seed_orders']}

def case(variant, mode, number, pgport):
    name = f'mixed_{number}_{variant}_{mode.lower()}' + ('_memory' if memory else '')
    if not memory:
        control([pgbin/'createdb.exe','-h','127.0.0.1','-p',pgport,'-U','forge',name])
    bind = port()
    caseenv = env | {'MARKETFORGE_BIND_ADDR':f'127.0.0.1:{bind}'}
    if not memory:
        caseenv['MARKETFORGE_DATABASE_URL'] = f'postgresql://forge@127.0.0.1:{pgport}/{name}'
    workdir = out / name
    workdir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    binary = out / f'{variant}-server.exe'
    process = None
    conn = None
    log = (out/f'{name}.log').open('w',encoding='utf-8')
    def stop():
        nonlocal process, conn
        if conn:
            conn.close()
            conn = None
        if process and process.poll() is None:
            process.terminate()
            process.wait(timeout=20)
        process = None
    def start():
        nonlocal process, conn
        process = subprocess.Popen([str(binary)],env=caseenv,cwd=workdir,stdout=log,
                                   stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,creationflags=flags)
        assert kernel.SetProcessAffinityMask(process._handle,4), ctypes.get_last_error()
        deadline = time.monotonic()+25
        while time.monotonic()<deadline:
            assert process.poll() is None, 'server exited, see '+str(log.name)
            try:
                c = http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',bind,timeout=20)
                c.request('GET','/health/ready')
                r = c.getresponse()
                r.read()
                c.close()
                if r.status==200:
                    conn = http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',bind,timeout=20)
                    return
            except OSError:
                pass
            time.sleep(.05)
        raise RuntimeError('server readiness exceeded 25 seconds')
    def request(method,path,body=None,key=None):
        headers = {'Content-Type':'application/json'}
        if key:
            headers['Idempotency-Key'] = key
        start_ns = time.perf_counter_ns()
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers=headers)
        response = conn.getresponse()
        raw = response.read()
        us = (time.perf_counter_ns()-start_ns)/1000
        decoded = json.loads(raw)
        assert 200<=response.status<300, (response.status,decoded)
        return decoded,us
    try:
        start()
        request('POST','/rooms',json.dumps({'scenario':scenario(mode),'agents':[],
                                         'autostart_agents':False}).encode())
        times=[]
        categories={}
        last=None
        for index,(body,expected) in enumerate(requests):
            key=f'command-{index}'
            receipt,us=request('POST','/rooms/mixed/instruments/BENCH/orders',body,key)
            assert receipt['accepted'], (index,receipt)
            normalized=[{k:v for k,v in event.items() if k!='seq'} for event in receipt['events']]
            assert normalized==normalized_expected(expected), (index,normalized,expected)
            times.append(us)
            kind=next(iter(json.loads(body)['action']))
            categories.setdefault(kind,[]).append(us)
            last=(body,key,receipt)
        book,_=request('GET','/rooms/mixed/instruments/BENCH/book')
        assert book==trace['final_book'], (book,trace['final_book'])
        # Recovery is outside timed request samples. Terminate only this owned
        # process after all acknowledged commands, then recover from real PG.
        if not memory:
            stop()
            start()
        recovered,_=request('GET','/rooms/mixed/instruments/BENCH/book')
        assert recovered==book
        replayed,_=request('POST','/rooms/mixed/instruments/BENCH/orders',last[0],last[1])
        assert replayed==last[2]
        unchanged,_=request('GET','/rooms/mixed/instruments/BENCH/book')
        assert unchanged==book
        row={'variant':variant,'mode':mode,'run':number,'commands':len(times),'latency':stats(times),
             'operations':{k:stats(v) for k,v in categories.items()},
             'all_events_and_final_book_match':True,'postgres_restart_recovery':not memory,
             'idempotency_replay':True}
        print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
        return row
    finally:
        stop()
        log.close()

assert not (data/'postmaster.pid').exists(), 'refusing to attach to a running cluster'
pgport=port()
started=False
try:
    if not memory:
        if not (data/'PG_VERSION').exists():
            control([pgbin/'initdb.exe','-D',data,'-U','forge','--auth=trust','--encoding=UTF8','--no-locale'])
        control([pgbin/'pg_ctl.exe','-D',data,'-w','-t','20','-l',out/'http-postgres.log',
                 '-o',f'-h 127.0.0.1 -p {pgport}','start'])
        started=True
    rows=[]
    for number,variant in enumerate(['stage2','current','current','stage2'],start=8):
        for mode in ['Spot','Perp']:
            rows.append(case(variant,mode,number,pgport))
    (out/('memory-http-results.json' if memory else 'http-results.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'scope':
        ('In-memory journal diagnostic, no persistence/restart qualification. ' if memory else 'Real private PostgreSQL default durability. ') +
        'Loopback HTTP/1.1 persistent connection, one closed-loop client. '
        '8 accounts, 100 live orders, initial 10 price levels per side, growing histories, deterministic 400-cycle stream. '
        'Request timing includes HTTP request through complete response-body read; serialization, JSON parsing/assertions, '
        'setup, restart and idempotent replay excluded. Fresh database/server per case, before/after/after/before order. '
        'Owned API process pinned to logical CPU 2, owned PG control processes/descendants to CPU 4, client to CPU 6. '
        'No queueing/open-loop/concurrent-client or production SLO claim. No dedicated warm-up; cold first requests included.'},indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
finally:
    if started:
        control([pgbin/'pg_ctl.exe','-D',data,'-w','-t','20','-m','fast','stop'])

import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import time
import ctypes
from ctypes import wintypes

kernel=ctypes.WinDLL('kernel32',use_last_error=True)
kernel.SetProcessAffinityMask.argtypes=[wintypes.HANDLE,ctypes.c_size_t]
kernel.SetProcessAffinityMask.restype=wintypes.BOOL

out=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
root=out.parents[1]
def run(binary, name):
    start=time.time()
    with (out/(name+'.json')).open('w',encoding='utf-8') as result, (out/(name+'.log')).open('w',encoding='utf-8') as log:
        process=subprocess.Popen([str(binary)],cwd=root,stdout=result,stderr=log,
                                 creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW)
        assert kernel.SetProcessAffinityMask(process._handle,4), ctypes.get_last_error()
        assert process.wait(timeout=240)==0
    value=json.loads((out/(name+'.json')).read_text())
    print(name,'rows',len(value['rows']),'seconds',round(time.time()-start,2),flush=True)

for index,variant in enumerate(['stage2','current','current','stage2']):
    run(out/(variant+'-mixed.exe'),f'paired-mixed-{index}-{variant}')
for kind, qualified in [('orders','qualified-orders.exe'),('matching','qualified-matching.exe')]:
    run(root/'.local/hotpath-optimization'/qualified,'guard-'+kind+'-stage2')
    run(out/('current-'+kind+'.exe'),'guard-'+kind+'-current')
